title: Egg's Perfectcraft
description: Adds 53 new mods to Minecraft that still keep the essence of vanilla.
body:
This is a lightweight Minecraft modpack built to make your world feel deeper and more immersive, while keeping the core vanilla experience intact.

You still play Minecraft the way you know it. Mining, crafting, building, and exploring stay balanced and familiar. Nothing is overpowered and nothing replaces the core progression

This is what i've always wanted in Minecraft, I hope you enjoy this modpack!
